mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above the prior 12-month average precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate tighter credit conditions.
failure_condition: Over 60-day rolling window, no significant negative returns (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS relative to INDPRO indicates strengthening labor market demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In 5 consecutive quarters of labor strength (PAYEMS/INDPRO > 1.02), 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in HOUST (household spending) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer demand weakens.
failure_condition: Over 100 instances of monthly HOUST declines, no negative 5-day forward returns observed (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO (industrial production) coincides with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as weak manufacturing output signals potential recession fears and safe-haven flows.
failure_condition: Three consecutive INDPRO declines fail to precede positive 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to deliver positive 60-day forward returns as lower unemployment is interpreted as a growth signal.
failure_condition: No significant positive 60-day returns in any 12-month window of UNRATE < 3.0 (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both PAYEMS and RSAFS (retail and services employment) above their 12-month averages predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as robust labor absorption supports economic expansion.
failure_condition: Across 50 such dual-strength episodes, 20-day returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDPC1 (GDP momentum) for two consecutive quarters is associated with negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as it signals weakening economic momentum.
failure_condition: Over 10 such 2Q declines, no negative 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPIAUCSL (inflation) above 2% for three consecutive months triggers negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as market anticipates rate hike risk.
failure_condition: In 20 such inflation spikes, no negative 5-day returns (p > 0.05).
